illustration.description: Flat cartoon vector illustration of a smiling young boy standing in a front-facing, relaxed pose with arms slightly away from the body and hands open. He has short tousled reddish-brown hair, big dark eyes, rosy pink cheeks and a small smile. He wears a red short-sleeve crew-neck t-shirt, blue denim jeans with rolled cuffs, and red-and-white high-top sneakers with white laces. Clean bold dark outlines, soft cel shading, warm skin tones, friendly children's book style. A soft pale pinkish oval shadow sits beneath his feet on a plain white background.
